title: RentalDVD
summary: A Java Swing desktop information system for VCD/DVD rental management featuring multi-item loan processing, overdue debt checks, automated late fee calculation, and JasperReports PDF generation.
description: RentalDVD is a desktop rental information system engineered with Java (JDK 21), Java Swing (Nimbus L&F), and MySQL (dbfilm). It automates film inventory tracking, member registration, multi-item loan checkouts, return date calculations, late fee penalties, and formal JasperReports 5.0.1 PDF reporting.
problem: Traditional VCD/DVD rental shops relied on manual paper logs for catalog tracking and member loans, causing inventory discrepancies, untracked overdue returns, uncollected late fees, and slow manual reporting.
solution: Developed a native Java desktop application featuring auto-numbering ID generators (IDxxx, FLxxx, PJ-YYYY-MM-DD-xxx), JCalendar date selection, real-time overdue loan verification, multi-item loan checkout tables, fine calculation engines, role-based dashboards (Admin & Cashier), and integrated JasperReports PDF compilation.

architecture.label: Relational DB
architecture.subtext: MySQL dbfilm Data Store via JDBC

implementation: Designed normalized MySQL database schema (user, anggota, film, pinjam, detail_pinjam, view_pinjam).
Developed central ConfigDB.java utility helper handling JDBC connections, dynamic JTable data binding, and primary key duplication checks.
Engineered multi-item rental transaction checkout with automated overdue loan checks (btnCari) and late penalty calculations.
Integrated JasperReports 5.0.1 framework with iText 2.1.7 for compiling dynamic PDF reports from JRXML templates.
Implemented Auto Numbering Generators for Members (IDxxx), Films (FLxxx), and Loans (PJ-YYYY-MM-DD-xxx).
challenges: Managing transactional multi-item loan inserts across parent pinjam and child detail_pinjam tables while maintaining database consistency.
Configuring JasperReports library dependencies and runtime JDBC parameter passing inside Java Swing desktop frames.
results: Automated 100% of film loan checkouts, return date tracking, and overdue fine calculations.
Eliminated manual catalog search delays through instant real-time JTable filtering.
Enabled one-click PDF report compilation for member databases and loan histories.
lessons: Decoupling database access logic into a central JDBC helper class (ConfigDB) greatly simplifies Swing GUI form development.
Pre-formatted report compilation engines like JasperReports deliver far cleaner PDF exports than custom canvas drawing.
